verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover each pillar on one platform: APM/tracing [datadog-docs-23], Log Management [datadog-docs-13], Dashboards/metrics [datadog-docs-12] and OpenTelemetry ingestion [datadog-docs-2]. A customer independently confirms the main advantage is correlating APM, custom metrics and logs via tagging, densely linked across the platform [datadog-comm-1], and notebooks hold metrics side by side during incidents [datadog-comm-6]. One critic calls the correlation weaker than Honeycomb, Dynatrace and Instana [datadog-comm-7], but that is a comparative opinion, not a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: first-party documentation in the pack detailing the cross-signal pivot mechanics (e.g. trace-to-log linking and shared tags), and uncontested hands-on corroboration of correlation quality.
